bio.text: Jaime R. Williams has represented the 59th Assembly District in Brooklyn, which includes Canarsie, Flatlands, Bergen Beach, Mill Basin and Gerritsen Beach, since her first term began on April 19, 2016.
She earned a bachelor's degree in social work from York College and a master's degree in social work from Fordham University.
Before the Assembly she counseled victims of domestic violence and served as Community Project Director for Brooklyn East at Catholic Charities.
